title: Spotted Dick Pudding with Fennel
description: A traditional British dessert with a hint of anise from fennel. A moist and flavorful pudding.
instructions: Grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, dried fruit, and fennel seeds (if using).
Add the spotted dick mix and stir until combined.
Add the butter and mix until the mixture forms a crumbly dough.
Transfer the dough to the prepared loaf pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes.
Transfer the pudding to a serving plate and serve warm, dust with powdered sugar (optional).
